system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, a father punishes his 10-year-old for not doing homework by withholding pocket money for a week and giving a verbal warning. Under Section 1567(2) as currently in force, does this fall within scope? Answer only "within scope" or "outside scope".
raw_response:
The applicable law is the Act Amending the Civil and Commercial Code (No. 24) B.E. 2567 (2024), which came into force on May 22, 2024.

This Act repealed Section 1567(2) of the Civil and Commercial Code. The former provision allowed a person with parental power to "punish the child in a reasonable manner for the purpose of discipline." As this provision is no longer in force as of the date specified, no action can fall within its scope.

outside scope
